title: Length of the encoded quantified formula
statement: Let $x$ and $qs$ be bit strings and let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula over natural-number-indexed variables. If $x$ is the self-delimiting pair encoding of $qs$ and the serialization of $\varphi$, then $2|qs|+2\leq |x|$.
hypotheses_covered: $x=\langle qs,\mathrm{enc}(\varphi)\rangle$, where $\varphi$ is a CNF formula over natural-number-indexed variables.
